name: AtlBreadcrumbs
purpose: Hierarchical location trail. Renders the path from a root section down to the current page so users can see and jump back through the hierarchy.

rules.statement: Surfacing the position of a deep page inside a multi-level information architecture (settings, docs, file trees).
Letting users navigate one or several levels back without relying on the browser back button.
Reinforcing where a detail view sits relative to its parent list.
Switching between sibling sections of a flat app.
rules.useInstead: AtlTabs — tabs communicate peer relationships, breadcrumbs communicate depth.

rules.statement: Stepping through an ordered flow (wizard, checkout).
rules.useInstead: A dedicated stepper component — steps imply forward/backward progress, not nested location.

rules.statement: renders a nav landmark with an aria-label
non-current items with href render as links

checks.test: renders an <a href> for non-current items with href
renders non-current items as links when href is provided
renders a link when href is provided and current is false

rules.statement: applies the is-current class to the current item

checks.test: adds is-current class to host of last item
applies is-current class when current is true

accessibility.keyboardBehavior: Items are links and reach focus via Tab in source order. Enter activates the focused link. The current item carries `aria-current="page"` and is announced as the active location. It is the last item unless an item sets `current` explicitly; if any does, only explicit values count.

mismatches.name: href
mismatches.reason: Not visual: it swaps the element from <span> to <a> and changes nothing drawn.

tokens.name: --ui-color-border-hover
tokens.intent: Hover state for decorative borders — slightly deeper than --ui-color-border.
constraints: Only use as :hover state — never as a resting border.

tokens.name: --ui-color-surface-sunken
tokens.intent: Recessed surface for input fields, code blocks, and inset containers.
constraints: Pair with --ui-color-text or --ui-color-text-muted only — never raw black/white.
Do not combine with elevation shadows — sunken surfaces should read as inset.

tokens.name: --ui-color-text
tokens.intent: Primary body and heading text colour. Use on --ui-color-surface and its raised/sunken variants.
constraints: Must meet >=4.5:1 contrast against the surface it renders on (verified for all --ui-color-surface* pairs).
Do not use as a fill colour — this is a foreground token.

tokens.name: --ui-color-text-muted
tokens.intent: Secondary text colour for helper copy, captions, and de-emphasised content.
constraints: Must meet >=4.5:1 contrast — verified against --ui-color-surface* but not against tinted surfaces.
Do not use for primary actions, form labels, or anything users must scan quickly.

tokens.name: --ui-focus-ring
tokens.intent: Double-ring box-shadow for :focus-visible — surface-coloured inner + primary outer for light/dark compatibility.
constraints: Apply via box-shadow on :focus-visible — never on :focus alone (mouse focus would flash the ring).
Do not override per component; consistency is the entire point of a global focus ring.

tokens.name: --ui-font-family
tokens.intent: Default UI typeface stack. Instrument Sans first, with system fallbacks for offline / first-paint (ADR-0035).
constraints: Declare it once on each component root — not per rule, and not left to the app shell: a component that depends on the consumer applying it renders in the app's font while its neighbours render this one (measured; ADR-0049).
Use --ui-font-display for the one display line per surface; everything interactive stays on this stack.

tokens.name: --ui-font-size-md
tokens.intent: Body copy size (1rem). The default for paragraphs and form inputs.
constraints: Do not interpolate between scale steps; pick the nearest defined value.
Treat this as the baseline — only step up/down when a hierarchy demands it.

tokens.name: --ui-font-size-sm
tokens.intent: Compact size (0.875rem). Use for secondary text, helper messages, and dense form labels.
constraints: Do not interpolate between scale steps; pick the nearest defined value.
Avoid combining with --ui-line-height-tight for multi-line copy — readability suffers.

tokens.name: --ui-font-weight-semibold
tokens.intent: Strong emphasis weight (600). Use for headings and primary calls-to-action.
constraints: Do not use weights above 600 — the type stack is not loaded with heavier cuts.

tokens.name: --ui-line-height-tight
tokens.intent: Compact leading (1.25) for headings and single-line UI text.
constraints: Do not use for multi-line body copy — readability suffers.

tokens.name: --ui-radius-sm
tokens.intent: Small rounding (0.5rem) for compact controls — badges, tags, inline chips.
constraints: Do not interpolate between scale steps; pick the nearest defined value.

tokens.name: --ui-spacing-1
tokens.intent: Hairline spacing (0.25rem). Use for icon-to-label gaps and tightest groupings.
constraints: Do not interpolate between scale steps; pick the nearest defined value.

tokens.name: --ui-spacing-2
tokens.intent: Tight spacing (0.5rem). Use for compact button padding and dense list rows.
constraints: Do not interpolate between scale steps; pick the nearest defined value.

tokens.name: --ui-transition-fast
tokens.intent: Composed transition shorthand: fast duration + ease-out. Use for hover/focus micro-interactions.
constraints: Apply to the `transition` property with the property name (e.g. `color var(--ui-transition-fast)`).
Respects prefers-reduced-motion through its constituent --ui-duration-fast token.
